title: Gunmen at a funeral: the Karak church attack
ticker: Jordan vows harshest penalties after attack on Karak church

scenes.title: Gunmen at a funeral
scenes.say: Gunmen opened fire on mourners at a church funeral in Jordan. Here's what we know.

scenes.title: Hammoud village, Karak governorate
scenes.say: It happened on Friday, 23 October, at St George's Greek Orthodox Church, in Hammoud village in southern Jordan's Karak governorate.
scenes.speak: It happened on Friday, the twenty-third of October, at Saint George's Greek Orthodox Church, in Hammoud village in southern Jordan's Karak governorate.

scenes.title: Nine dead, dozens wounded
scenes.say: 7 died on the spot. 2 more died in hospital the next day, taking the toll to 9. 34 were wounded, and Jordan declared 3 days of mourning.
scenes.speak: Seven died on the spot. Two more died in hospital the next day, taking the toll to nine. Thirty-four were wounded, and Jordan declared three days of mourning.

scenes.title: What the CCTV shows

photos.caption: An armed man walks towards the church
They take cover by a low wall

scenes.say: Security-camera footage on state TV appears to show 2 men with handguns opening fire. A third, with a semi-automatic rifle, joins them. All 3 then run towards the church.
scenes.speak: Security-camera footage on state TV appears to show two men with handguns opening fire. A third, with a semi-automatic rifle, joins them. All three then run towards the church.

scenes.title: 15 minutes into the funeral
scenes.say: A mourner told AP the shooting began about 15 minutes into the funeral. Another witness said the gunmen fired for several minutes, inside and outside the church.
scenes.speak: A mourner told A P the shooting began about fifteen minutes into the funeral. Another witness said the gunmen fired for several minutes, inside and outside the church.

scenes.text: Jordan will confront the terrorist act that targeted Karak with the harshest penalties.
scenes.say: King Abdullah said Jordan will confront the terrorist act that targeted Karak with the harshest penalties. He has ordered an iron fist against those responsible.

scenes.title: The questions investigators face
items: Any link to a militant group
scenes.say: The attackers haven't been identified, and no arrests have been announced. Officials say it's too early to say whether they had links to any group.

scenes.title: Karak has been hit before

items.what: Gunmen kill 10, near the Crusader castle

scenes.say: Karak is home to a Christian minority, and it has been targeted before. In 2016, gunmen killed 10 people there, 7 of them police officers.
scenes.speak: Karak is home to a Christian minority, and it has been targeted before. In twenty sixteen, gunmen killed ten people there, seven of them police officers.

scenes.title: A stable partner in a region at war
items: Jordan is a moderate, stable state
Modi and King Abdullah met in Amman in 2025
scenes.say: For India, Jordan is a stable partner in a turbulent region. Modi and King Abdullah stressed a common stance against terror when they met in Amman last December.
